verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a self-serve sandbox, separate from production, that covers all products except Connected Account APIs. It has per-product simulation docs (payments, payouts, issuing, risk), and its quickstart walks through a full end-to-end payment in the sandbox. The CLI defaults to sandbox, and the Developer MCP can simulate events. However, nothing in the evidence documents test card numbers or simulating declines and disputes. Missing for 10: documented test cards for decline and other scenarios, dispute simulation in sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity to production.
